title: Beautiful!
body: This app is fantastic! It offers a seamless, ad-free experience paired with a beautifully designed interface. The ease of use is truly unparalleled, making it a pleasure to navigate. I’m incredibly grateful to the developers for creating such an amazing and helpful tool. Adding a widget would make it even better, but even as it stands, this app surpasses many paid alternatives in quality and functionality!

author: rodgjosue

title: User friendly, simple capabilities
body:
Super super easy to use! Stylish and aesthetically pleasing, love the colors! I love being able to categorize them and sort them. 

With it being so simple to use, I do wish there was an option to add a note to a day with an individual, one-time action taken per larger goal; and if those actions could then be compiled to see somewhere as a log. A large goal like “Prioritize My Marriage” can take a lot of forms, so it would be nice to see how I did that over a year and had a list of “accomplishments” or “actions taken” to celebrate to look back and reflect on. Just a thought for the developer! A capability like that would help someone like me a lot and make this app even more of a valuable tool!

title: Love the App

title: Simple but functional
body: Has everything you need for keeping track of your habits in an easy and efficient manner. Only thing I would add is an Apple Watch companion for a more accessible way to checkmark an accomplishment habit. Only really downside is that it seems a hobby project by the developer as (s)he doesn’t monetize the app - this sadly often leaves the project sooner or later abandoned. We’ll see…
